QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Chun Ji
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to go say hi to #b#p900014##k, a resident of the city. Let's go greet #p900014#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked in on #p900014#, a resident of #m10003000#. Man, they were incredibly grumpy.

0.0: "Quite some time has passed since you became a resident of this city. In that sense, I think it would be good to go say hi to #p900014# now. #p900014# is a bit of a difficult person to deal with, but somehow, you might be able to handle him well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Who are you? I hope you're not disturbing me for no good reason. If you thought I'd leisurely chat with someone like you, I'd like to tell you that you're gravely mistaken.
1.1: Hm? #p425# told you to come say hi to me...? That girl... Fine. If that's what she thought... Well, I suppose I can do a simple greeting. Alright, if you're done with that "greeting," get the hell out of here.

level.0: Are you seriously talking to me with that measly level?
